briefdescription.para: Real cloud SDK implementations for S3, Azure Storage, and Google Cloud Storage.

detaileddescription.para:
0.0.15
This file provides real SDK implementations that can be registered as callbacks with ThemisDB's cloud backup system. Each provider is conditionally compiled based on availability of the respective cloud SDK.

Build flags:
THEMIS_WITH_S3_SDK: Enable AWS SDK for C++ integration
THEMIS_WITH_AZURE_SDK: Enable Azure Storage Blobs SDK integration
THEMIS_WITH_GCS_SDK: Enable Google Cloud C++ Client Libraries integration
